name: achievement-tile
title: Achievement tile
description: A badge you earned or can still earn: icon, name, how to get it, and a locked, in progress or unlocked state that reads in words, with a one-time shine.
docs: title and description are the heading and the how-to-earn line, which stays visible in every state. state is 'locked' (an outline, dim, with the word Locked), 'progress' (a bar with '7 of 10' in text, from progress { current, goal }) or 'unlocked' (a filled tile with the date from unlockedAt, written in locale and timeZone; a date-only string is a day on the calendar). Every tile has the same minimum height and fills its grid cell, so a row lines up. When the state changes to unlocked after the tile was drawn, a short shine crosses it once (left out under reduced motion) and the unlock is announced politely. icon is any node, drawn at 20px. labels carries every word.
